description.zh-TW: 將選定的 Spring Cloud OpenFeign 呼叫導向 Echo，沿用既有 Feign interface 與下游 URL。
description.en: Route selected Spring Cloud OpenFeign calls to Echo while keeping existing interfaces and downstream URLs.

description.zh-TW: 安裝到 Client AP 的普通 Starter JAR。
description.en: Standalone starter JAR for your client application.

description.zh-TW: 含 JAR、原始碼、README、本機 Maven POM、YAML 範例與校驗碼。
description.en: Includes JAR, sources, README, local Maven POM, YAML example and checksums.

paragraphs.zh-TW: 應用需已使用 Spring Cloud OpenFeign，並配對相容的 Boot／Cloud 版本。
paragraphs.en: Your application must already use Spring Cloud OpenFeign with compatible Boot and Cloud versions.

paragraphs.zh-TW: 將 JAR 放入應用的 libs/，在 build.gradle 加入：
paragraphs.en: Place the JAR in your application's libs/ directory and add to build.gradle:

paragraphs.zh-TW: 解壓完整 ZIP，在該目錄執行本機安裝，再加入下方依賴；不需申請 Maven Central。
paragraphs.en: Extract the full ZIP, install from that directory, then add the dependency. No Maven Central account is required.

paragraphs.zh-TW: 將設定加入模擬環境，設定 ECHO_CLIENT_ENABLED=true 後重啟應用。停用時改為 false 並重啟；未選定的 client 仍走原後端。
paragraphs.en: Add this configuration to your mock environment, set ECHO_CLIENT_ENABLED=true and restart. Set false and restart to disable. Unselected clients still call the original backend.

hint.zh-TW: 填入應用可連線的 Echo 位址，保留部署路徑與 /mock。
hint.en: Use an Echo address reachable from your application, including its context path and /mock.

hint.zh-TW: 填入 contextId；沒有指定 contextId 時填入 name。保留原本的下游 URL。
hint.en: Use contextId, or name if contextId is not specified. Keep the original downstream URL.

paragraphs.zh-TW: 在 Echo 建立對應 path／method 的模擬規則，再呼叫應用原有業務入口，到「請求紀錄」確認命中的規則與回應。匹配路徑不需加 /mock。
paragraphs.en: Create an Echo rule for the actual path and method, call your existing business endpoint, then check the matching rule and response in Request Logs. Omit /mock from the matching path.

paragraphs.zh-TW: 已測組合的 Boot 3／4 可沿用同一份 SDK 與設定。升級仍需配對 Cloud 版本；OpenFeign 5 已移除 OkHttp 自動整合。詳細版本、必要依賴及公司自訂 codec／認證／TLS／LoadBalancer 接入限制見 ZIP 內 README。
paragraphs.en: Tested Boot 3 / 4 combinations use the same SDK and configuration. Upgrade matching Cloud versions as well; OpenFeign 5 removed automatic OkHttp integration. See the ZIP README for tested versions, required dependencies and custom codec, authentication, TLS and LoadBalancer integration limits.
